notes: Intrinsics cannot be changed or removed in game; planner choices describe desired loot.
The current page does not document a separate intrinsic family list or item feats.
Intrinsic rank selection/capacity wording is ambiguous: Slots says highest Power-qualified rank; Selection Logic says highest affordable rank and describes rank cost deductions.
Skill totals can also be limited by invested ranks; this catalog describes item contributions only.
Non-generation Disruption changes can exceed the fresh-drop two-thirds-of-Power restriction.
Positive ranks requiring Power above 50 are omitted from the playable catalog.
